book.name: Pilemon
book.title: Rau To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Pilemon Philemon—Filemon

content: You Paulus. You nambesmbees pa Yesu Krisi, tauto aazne tighur ghou naneep ila ruum to yabyabuuŋ lolo. O Pilemon, yeru toŋvetaz toit Timoti nimbood rau tonene ilat tiom pasa, itiŋa taluplup ghiit pa uraat to Krisi, ve lolomai payom kat.
Ve saveeŋ tonene ila to livuud ite Apia, yesuru Arkipus to yeiŋa ninim ndaaba to Krisi ve niparab ariaŋa pa saveeŋ toni. Ve ila to lupuuŋ to Krisi to tiluplup di pa suŋuuŋ ila ruum tiom ne paam.
Poia to Tamaan Maaron ve Tiina toit Yesu Krisi iza tiam, ve tiŋgin gham aneep pooi toman lolomim luuma. Onoon.
Ŋgar to Pilemon igham Paulus lolo poia
O Pilemon, sawa isob to matag iŋgal ghom ila suŋuuŋ tiou, you napait Maaron tiou toman lolog poia.
Pasa, naloŋlooŋ varum tighaze yom ughur ila to Tiina toit Yesu ariaŋa, ve lolom pa Maaron tamtoghon toni patabuaŋa tisob, ve ughamgham poian di. Kol 1:4
Ghurla toit, nene ilup ghiit tanim ee moghon wa. Tovenen suŋuuŋ tiou iŋaŋarua Maaron payom naghaze ghurla tiom tonanan inim ataam payom ve uwatag katin mbeb popoiadi naol to tagham di ila to Krisi.
Tazig, you nawatag: Yom upapalot Maaron tamtoghon toni, ve ugham di lolodi poia. Ŋgar tiom to lolom pa tamtoghon ve ughamgham poian di, nene igham ghou lolog poia kat, ve ipariaaŋ ghou paam.
Paulus ighaze Pilemon lolo imuul pa Onesimus

O Pilemon, matag iŋgal mbeb eez to naghaze ughami. Mbeb tonene, ighaze ughami, nene deŋia. Ughita. Ituru tanim Krisi le wa. Tovenen you irau nasaav ariaŋa payom pa ugham mbeb tonene. Eemoghon lolog pa nagham ghom venen maau.

You naghaze naghason ghom pooi itaghon ataam to lolood pa tauud. Ughita, you Paulus, aazne nanim olman wa. Ve nagham Krisi nagho ve navovotia aliŋa pa tamtoghon. Tauto aazne, tighur ghou nalooŋ nala ruum to yabyabuuŋ.

Naghaze naghason ghom pa natug Onesimus. Sawa to nanepneep ila ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene lolo, ye inim peria tiou, ve nasavia Krisi varu pani. Tauto itoor ŋgar toni ila pa Maaron, le aazne naghita inimale natug. Kol 4:9
Onoon, ye mbesooŋa tiom. Eemoghon muuŋ, ye iuul ghom kat maau. Ve aazne, ye irau iuul ghom, ve iuul ghou paam.
You lolog pani kat. Eemoghon you pale napamuula ilat tiom.
Onoon, aazne tighur ghou nalooŋ nala ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene lolo pasa, navovotia varu poia. Tovenen naghaze naŋguruut Onesimus ineep toman ghou, leso igham inam ve iuul ghou.

Eemoghon lolog pa nagham mbeb eta itaghon taug ŋgar tiou maau. Ve irau nazoorndug payom pa ugham ŋgar tonene maau. Naghaze ughami toman lolom poia. Ighaze uyok, ghoro nakis Onesimus ineep toman ghou. Ighaze maau, ghoro imuul ilat tiom. 2Kor 9:7

Iit takankaan pa pughu to Onesimus ipul ghom pa soso ris tonene. Nene avaat ataam to Maaron itoor Onesimus ŋgar toni, ve inim Krisi le. Leso imuul ilat tiom, ve yamru alup gham ve aneep itaghoni gha ila.

Sawa to ye ilat ivot, ughita inimale mbesooŋa sorok moghon malep. Onoon, ye mbesooŋa tiom. Eemoghon yom irau ughita inimale toŋvetaz to Krisi, ve lolom pani kat. You paam, lolog pani. Eemoghon yom pale lolom pani kat. Pasa, yamru anim Tiina toit Krisi le wa. Tovenen ye inim toŋvetaz tiom to Krisi, ve ye pale inim mbesooŋa poia eez payom paam. 1Kor 7:21+; Ep 6:9; 1Tim 6:2
Tovenen ighaze yom ughita ghou ughaze itam ite you, ve ituru lupuuŋ toit ee moghon, ghoro sawa to Onesimus ilat ivot, ughami toman lolom poia, raraate inimale ugham ghou.
Ve ighaze ye igham sosor eta payom, ma ye le bun eta ineep ilat tiom, ughur izag pani. Sawa sine to ighaze nalat, ghoro nagharaata.

Nene taug nimag to nambood saveeŋ tonene. Onoon kat, you pale nayat bun toni isob ilat tiom. Eemoghon yom uwatag: Bun tiom tiina eez to ineep tiou ne. Pasa you, tauto ugham nepooŋ poia ila to Krisi. Eemoghon irau avog ila pa mbeb tonene maau.
Aa tazig, ituru tanim Tiina toit Krisi le wa. Tovenen naghaze uul ghou ve ugham mbeb tonene. Leso urab ateg, ve ugham ghou lolog poia itaghon ŋgar to Krisi.
Sawa to nambood rau tonene, lolog ru payom maau. You nawatag: Yom pale utaghon aliŋag. Ve tonene moghon maau. Matag iŋgal naghaze yom pale ugham mbeb ite paam ilib pa mbeb tonene.
O, ve mbeb ite. Naghaze yom ughur ruum suruvu eta isaŋan ghou pataghaaŋ. Pasa, naghur ila naghaze Maaron pale ilooŋ suŋuuŋ tiam, ve ipas ghou navot pa ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene, ve nalat.
Paulus ipasob saveeŋ toni
Itaad ite Epapras, ndag poia toni ilat payom paam. Yeru ninepneep ila ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene lolo pasa, nitaghon Krisi. Kol 1:7, 4:12
Ve ye moghon maau. Markus, Aristarkus, Demas, ve Lukas to yeiŋa niluplup ghei pa uraat ne, yes paam tigham ndag poia todi ilat payom. Mbaŋ 15:37+, 19:29, 27:2; Kol 4:14; 2Tim 4:10+
Poia to Tiina toit Yesu Krisi iza to yam asob tonanan. Onoon.

footnotes.text: Ila yes Grika aliŋadi, pisis Onesimus pughu, nene: ‘iuul.’

Ŋgara pida matadi iŋgal tighaze mbeb ite paam to Paulus isavia, nene vene: Pilemon pale ipul Onesimus sorok. Leso inim mbesooŋa sorok muul sob. Pasa, ŋgar to tagham tamtoghon tinim mbesooŋa sorok, nene deŋia pa Krisi ŋgar toni maau.
